events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect sender check script and T-421
events.input: $ sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs | grep -nE "TANTRA|argv|usage|Usage" | head; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ | head; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py show T-421 2>/dev/null | tail -15
